mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates sustained monetary accommodation that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate rise above 8.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in housing starts (HOUST < 600) and GDP growth (GDPC1 < 13400) indicates contractionary economic conditions that reduce corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when HOUST < 600 and GDPC1 < 13400.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL index values above 220 indicate elevated inflation, prompting Federal Reserve rate hike expectations that increase equity discount rates and reduce valuations, causing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales above $380,000 million indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns through sustained earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS > 380,000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 95.

mechanism_narrative: Joint weakness in payroll employment (PAYEMS < 130500) and housing starts (HOUST < 600) indicates broad economic slowdown that lowers consumer confidence and corporate investment, producing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS < 130500 and HOUST < 600.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary easing (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2%) combined with industrial weakness (INDPRO < 95.5) creates a low-inflation, low-growth environment where equity valuations rise despite economic softness, yielding positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2 and INDPRO < 95.5.
